title: Graph Rewriting Dynamics
tagline: Compare four rewrite strategies by their asymptotic work per reduction step.

curves.label: Critical-Pair Enumeration
curves.code: for (let a=0;a<n;a++) for (let b=a+1;b<n;b++){ enumerateOverlaps(a,b); resolveCriticalPair(a,b); }
curves.name: Critical-Pair Enumeration

curves.label: Backtracking Strategy Search
curves.code: function search(k){ if(k===0) return; for (let cand of candidates(k)){ commitRewrite(cand); search(k-1); undo(); } } search(n/2);
curves.name: Backtracking Strategy Search
